description: This file is a Perl script used for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images. It contains functions for reading, writing, parsing, and constructing firmware partitions, as well as handling firmware file data, metadata, and trailer information. The script also includes command-line argument parsing for packaging and unpacking firmware images, with options for various firmware components such as RedBoot, Kernel, Ramdisk, and others.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data with 0xFF bytes up to the specified total length.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to the input length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold the specified data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary representation of a partition entry with optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry and extracts partition details and skip regions.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Locates the partition table within firmware data buffer.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the entire partition table and returns an array of partition info.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block for use in firmware images.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Constructs binary trailer data for firmware components.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints details of the Sercomm RedBoot trailer from firmware data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the optional Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk partitions accordingly.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Repairs and updates in-memory partition list based on firmware buffer's partition table.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Constructs the binary partition table from in-memory partition descriptions.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles the firmware image file from partition data stored in memory.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity check routine for partition table data, mainly for testing.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints formatted information about all current partitions.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Provides a default list of standard firmware partitions.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads a firmware image file into partition data structures, parsing partition table and data.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Loads partition data from files into memory for further processing.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Determines and assigns start offsets and sizes to partitions, adjusting for overlaps and layout constraints.
